blurb: Guests can rent beach equipment like umbrellas, chairs, shade canopies, and body boards with delivery, setup, and pickup at Buckroe Beach. They can take regular or private eFoil lessons with clear instruction to build confidence and experience riding above the water. Kayak and paddleboard rentals are available with life vests and safety gear to explore the calm waters and local wildlife of Chesapeake Bay. Private watersports party rentals are offered for groups at Buckroe Beach or other location
